question_stem:
A small solenoid is placed inside a larger solenoid, as shown in Fig. 6.1.
The larger solenoid is connected to a battery and a switch.
The smaller solenoid is connected to a sensitive ammeter.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The switch is closed and a steady current exists in the larger solenoid.
Compare the magnetic flux in the smaller solenoid with that in the larger solenoid.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Compare the magnetic flux density in the smaller solenoid with that in the larger solenoid.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Use Lenz's law to explain why a magnetic force acts on the smaller solenoid as the switch is opened and state whether the force is attractive or repulsive.
